response.overview: Super Bowl XXIX, played on January 29, 1995, at Joe Robbie Stadium in Miami, Florida, was a historic blowout as the San Francisco 49ers defeated the San Diego Chargers 49-26. The victory gave San Francisco its fifth Super Bowl title, making them the first franchise to reach that milestone. The game was also notable for Steve Young stepping out of Joe Montana’s shadow, delivering a legendary performance that solidified his place among the NFL’s greatest quarterbacks.
response.tagline: San Francisco 49ers vs. San Diego Chargers
response.title: Super Bowl XXIX
